ORIGINAL CHARACTERS. ORIGINAL CREATORS.

Six archives. Thousands of drawings.

3,493 distinct text artworks, imported November 24, 2026. 317 duplicate records were merged while retaining their source information. Collection counts can overlap when a drawing appears in more than one archive.

This is a bundled snapshot, not a live search of every ASCII site. Drawings remain text. Only surrounding padding, HTML space entities, line endings and tab stops are normalized. Signatures stay in the artwork; source titles, dates and author notices become metadata. Oversized layouts, unsupported character layouts and non-art sections are excluded.

ASCII Bin

97 drawings represented · Original collection · Collection CC0; individual artist rights apply

The collector’s CC0 dedication covers the compilation and rights the collector holds; it cannot waive other artists’ rights.

Candy Box 2

Roy/SAC

The artist released his ASCII and ANSI work into the public domain. DOS CP437 characters are decoded into their corresponding text characters.

Keep the credit attached.

Copy and download include the source, named artist and reuse terms. Licenses vary by piece; the entire library is not public domain. Art and compilation rights belong to their respective creators. Request a correction or removal.
